result:
These queries come from the first page alone; I could not run any of them. Two assumptions are worth knowing:

- **Number strings:** M13 turns number strings into numbers with `parseJson`, since the page rules out reading a number from a string implicitly.
- **Key strings:** `groupBy` is assumed to turn string keys into keywords, as in the page's `["b" "a" "b"]` example.

M14 has no regex, so punctuation is removed by splitting on `.` and `;` and re-joining with spaces. M12 tests the whole line for "timeout", which is safe here because the timestamp, level and service never contain it.

M1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (/email | lower) | sort
M2: filter ~(/profile/age | type | eq ::number !| false) | * /profile/age | :a / | sum | div (a | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
M3: filter ~(/profile/country | type | eq ::string !| false) | groupBy ~(/profile/country | upper) * count
M4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | sort ~[(/priority | mul -1) /id] | take 2 * /id
M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") * count
M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
M7: /dependencies | entries * {:name (/0 | keyword) :version (/1 | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/)))} | sort ~/name
M8: filter ~(:s /status | ["paid" "shipped"] | contains s) * (/items * (mul /qty /price)) | flat | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~/customer * (* (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | mul 100 | round | div 100)} | sort ~[(/total | mul -1) /customer] | take 2
M10: /services | entries | filter ~(/1/tls/enabled | eq true !| false) | sort ~/0 * (/1 | [/host (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join ":")
M11: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR" !| false) | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) * count
M12: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | :l / | ["WARN" "ERROR"] | contains l !| false) | filter ~(lower | contains "timeout") | * (split " " | /2) | distinct | sort
M13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(split "," | /2 | ne "" !| false) | groupBy ~(split "," | /1) * (* (split "," | /2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round)
M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | lower | split "." | join " " | split ";" | join " " | split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | groupBy ~/ * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~[(/count | mul -1) /word] | take 3
